notes: The V2 personal/trip/engagement/value/context weights are reused by role, without customer-specific fitting.
Interpretation levels express provisional transfer strength, not measured reliability or behavioral probabilities.
Food details support food-experience interest, not preference for wine or every menu.
Novelty is a bounded inference from actual experience diversity. Documentation detail alone contributes nothing.
Missing preference is neutral. All monetary and operating inputs must be supplied explicitly.
A claim's source roots are allocated to at most one personal factor per option, with direct feature match preceding broad novelty inference.
Opportunity cost of spending time is a generic scenario judgment, not a learned personal time value.
No willingness-to-pay threshold or participant probability is inferred from these heuristics.
